8. EVIDENCE-SUPPORTED CONCLUSION
   The pooled matched-pair result (ratio 1.456, CI [1.300,1.630]) shows no measurable v6 advantage across the pre-registered unstable trajectories; per-trajectory results are reported above. v6 did change concurrency with the environment, but the adaptation did not translate into lower completion time than aria2-F under these controlled conditions. No general-superiority, mobile-network, or real-world claim is made.

Limitations: controlled synthetic server; five pre-registered trajectories; 30 pairs each; aria2's 1 MiB minimum split and initial non-range probe; v6 was previously found slower than the best fixed concurrency on every live trajectory (PROJECT_CONTEXT 22.34).
